message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_12787",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadLayer",
    "line":596,"var":"layer.hierarchy_offset","code":"xcf_io >> layer.hierarchy_offset >> layer.mask_offset;",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"hierarchy_offset is read from untrusted input data, controlling where the hierarchy data will be read from"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadLayer",
    "line":604,"var":"layer.hierarchy_offset","code":"xcf_io.device()->seek(layer.hierarchy_offset);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Seeks to the attacker-controlled hierarchy_offset position which may be past end of buffer"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadHierarchy",
    "line":980,"var":"bpp","code":"xcf_io >> width >> height >> bpp >> offset;",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"If the seek position is past end of data, this read fails and bpp remains uninitialized on the stack. No error check follows."},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadHierarchy",
    "line":986,"var":"bpp","code":"qWarning() << \"Found layer of type RGB but with bpp != 3\" << bpp;",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Uninitialized bpp is passed to qWarning which calls QLocaleData::longLongToString/qulltoa, triggering use-of-uninitialized-value"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadLayer",
     "line":596,"operands":["layer.hierarchy_offset"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadHierarchy",
     "line":980,"operands":["bpp","xcf_io.status()"],
     "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"xcf_io.status()","right":"QDataStream::Ok"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadHierarchy",
     "line":986,"operands":["bpp","3"],
     "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"bpp","right":"3"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadLayer",
       "line":596,"operands":["layer.hierarchy_offset"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadLayer",
       "line":604,"operands":["layer.hierarchy_offset"]},
      "type":"data","via":["layer.hierarchy_offset"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadLayer",
       "line":604,"operands":["layer.hierarchy_offset"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadHierarchy",
       "line":980,"operands":["bpp"]},
      "type":"control","via":["xcf_io.device()->seek(layer.hierarchy_offset)"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadHierarchy",
       "line":980,"operands":["bpp"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/imageformats/xcf.cpp","function":"XCFImageFormat::loadHierarchy",
       "line":986,"operands":["bpp"]},
      "type":"data","via":["bpp"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
